single.sql:
SELECT buffer_kib, cycles_per_load
FROM latency
WHERE component IN ('l1', 'l2', 'dram') AND stride_bytes = 0
single.transformScript:
# The L1, L2 and DRAM buffer sweeps form one curve: one point per buffer
# size, the median over the repetitions.
df = df.groupby('buffer_kib', as_index=False)['cycles_per_load'].median()
df = df.sort_values('buffer_kib')
single.layoutScript:
# Redraws the figure like dgx-spark/latency/plot/plot_chain.py, in the house style
# of plotstyle.py, so it matches the slide image.
import matplotlib as mpl
HOUSE = {
    "font.size": 18, "axes.titlesize": 18, "axes.labelsize": 18,
    "xtick.labelsize": 16, "ytick.labelsize": 16, "legend.fontsize": 9,
    "legend.title_fontsize": 12, "figure.titlesize": 20,
    "axes.spines.right": False, "axes.spines.top": False,
    "axes.grid": True, "grid.alpha": 0.3, "lines.linewidth": 2.2, "lines.markersize": 6,
}

def start(fig, size):
    """Throw away the default rendering and start a clean figure in the house style."""
    mpl.rcdefaults()
    mpl.rcParams.update(HOUSE)
    fig.clear()
    fig.set_layout_engine("constrained")
    fig.set_size_inches(*size)

L1_SRAM_KIB = 128           # unified L1 + shared memory per SM
L2_KIB = 24 * 1024          # 24 MiB

def customize_matplotlib(fig, ax, config):
    start(fig, (10, 5.5))
    ax = fig.add_subplot()
    ax.plot(df["buffer_kib"], df["cycles_per_load"], marker="o")

    # The two capacities the curve should step at.
    ymax = df["cycles_per_load"].max()
    for x, name, yf in [(L1_SRAM_KIB, " 128 KiB\n L1 + SMEM", 0.60), (L2_KIB, " 24 MiB\n L2", 0.26)]:
        ax.axvline(x, color="gray", ls=":", lw=1.5)
        ax.text(x, ymax * yf, name, ha="left", va="top", fontsize=14, color="gray")

    ax.set_xscale("log", base=2)
    ticks = [1, 4, 16, 64, 256, 1024, 4096, 16384, 65536, 262144, 1048576]
    lo, hi = df["buffer_kib"].min(), df["buffer_kib"].max()
    ax.set_xticks([t for t in ticks if lo <= t <= hi])
    ax.set_xticklabels([f"{t} KiB" if t < 1024 else f"{t // 1024} MiB" for t in ax.get_xticks()],
                       rotation=45, ha="right")
    ax.set_xlabel("buffer size (KiB/MiB)")
    ax.set_ylabel("latency (cycles per load)")
    ax.grid(True, which="both", alpha=0.3)

import math
from matplotlib.ticker import NullFormatter, ScalarFormatter
TITLE = "Shared memory"

def customize_matplotlib(fig, ax, config):
    start(fig, (8, 5))
    # These four go on one slide at a quarter of its width each, so the type
    # is pushed above the house size.
    mpl.rcParams.update({"font.size": 24, "axes.titlesize": 26, "axes.labelsize": 24,
                         "xtick.labelsize": 22, "ytick.labelsize": 22})
    ax = fig.add_subplot()

    strided = df[df["stride_bytes"] > 0].sort_values("stride_bytes")
    (line,) = ax.plot(strided["stride_bytes"], strided["cycles_per_load"],
                      marker="o", markersize=5, linewidth=2.8)
    # The random cycle (the run without --stride) as a dashed reference line.
    random = df[df["stride_bytes"] == 0]
    if not random.empty:
        ax.axhline(random["cycles_per_load"].iloc[0], linestyle="--", linewidth=2,
                   color=line.get_color(), alpha=0.7)

    ax.set_xscale("log", base=2)
    # Label every other power of two: at this type size all eleven would collide.
    strides = sorted(strided["stride_bytes"].unique())
    ax.set_xticks([x for x in strides if round(math.log2(x)) % 2 == 0])
    ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(ScalarFormatter())
    ax.xaxis.set_minor_formatter(NullFormatter())
    ax.set_xlabel("stride (bytes)", labelpad=10)
    ax.set_ylabel("latency (cycles per load)", labelpad=12)
    ax.set_title(TITLE, fontweight="normal")
    ax.grid(True, which="major", alpha=0.3)

import math
from matplotlib.ticker import NullFormatter, ScalarFormatter
TITLE = "DRAM"

def customize_matplotlib(fig, ax, config):
    start(fig, (8, 5))
    # These four go on one slide at a quarter of its width each, so the type
    # is pushed above the house size.

                         "xtick.labelsize": 22, "ytick.labelsize": 22})
    ax = fig.add_subplot()

    strided = df[df["stride_bytes"] > 0].sort_values("stride_bytes")
    (line,) = ax.plot(strided["stride_bytes"], strided["cycles_per_load"],
                      marker="o", markersize=5, linewidth=2.8)
    # The random cycle (the run without --stride) as a dashed reference line.
    random = df[df["stride_bytes"] == 0]
    if not random.empty:
        ax.axhline(random["cycles_per_load"].iloc[0], linestyle="--", linewidth=2,
                   color=line.get_color(), alpha=0.7)

    ax.set_xscale("log", base=2)
    # Label every other power of two: at this type size all eleven would collide.
    strides = sorted(strided["stride_bytes"].unique())
    ax.set_xticks([x for x in strides if round(math.log2(x)) % 2 == 0])
    ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(ScalarFormatter())
    ax.xaxis.set_minor_formatter(NullFormatter())
    ax.set_xlabel("stride (bytes)", labelpad=10)
    ax.set_ylabel("latency (cycles per load)", labelpad=12)
    ax.set_title(TITLE, fontweight="normal")
    ax.grid(True, which="major", alpha=0.3)

        bars = ax.bar(range(len(cy)), cy, color=colors, width=0.75)

import numpy as np

def customize_matplotlib(fig, ax, config):
    start(fig, (8.5, 6.4))
    ax = fig.add_subplot()

    n = int(max(df["reader"].max(), df["target"].max())) + 1
    matrix = np.full((n, n), np.nan)
    for r, t, v in zip(df["reader"], df["target"], df["cycles_per_load"]):
        matrix[int(r), int(t)] = v
    off = matrix.copy()
    np.fill_diagonal(off, np.nan)            # the diagonal is a local access, not a hop

    im = ax.imshow(off, cmap="viridis_r", vmin=np.nanmin(off), vmax=np.nanmax(off))
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            if i == j:
                ax.text(j, i, "self", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=8, color="0.4")
            else:
                v = matrix[i, j]
                ax.text(j, i, f"{v:.0f}", ha="center", va="center", fontsize=9,
                        color="white" if v > 185 else "black")
    ax.set_xticks(range(n)); ax.set_xticklabels(range(n), fontsize=13)
    ax.set_yticks(range(n)); ax.set_yticklabels(range(n), fontsize=13)
    ax.set_xlabel("target rank"); ax.set_ylabel("reader rank")
    ax.set_title("every pair, one reader at a time")
    ax.grid(False)
    for s in ax.spines.values():
        s.set_visible(False)
    cb = fig.colorbar(im, ax=ax, fraction=0.046, pad=0.03)
    cb.set_label("cycles per load", fontsize=15)
    cb.ax.tick_params(labelsize=13)
